rollback_method: Stop new releases, deallocate open lines and re-release them in the previous WMS
depends_on: Order management hold on new releases and a wave cut-off agreed with the carriers
point_of_no_return: Lines already picked and staged cannot be re-released; they must ship first

rollback_method: Re-key receipts booked since go-live into the previous WMS and reverse the matching ERP goods-receipt postings
depends_on: ASN and PO mapping to the previous system; ERP interface postings frozen
point_of_no_return: Once ERP invoices are matched to the receipts they can only be corrected by credit note

rollback_method: Cancel or re-issue in-flight transfers and reconcile in-transit stock at both ends
depends_on: Transport shipments identified; the other site agrees the cut-over time
point_of_no_return: Transfers already received at the destination must be reversed there by a return transfer

rollback_method: Replay the movements since go-live into the previous ledger by reference; they cannot be undone, only replayed
depends_on: Movement history exported by reference and bin; ERP stock feed paused
point_of_no_return: Cannot be reversed once the nightly stock feed to the ERP has run

rollback_method: Cancel open count tasks and recount the bins touched since go-live
depends_on: Stock movements replayed first so counts are against the right balance
point_of_no_return: Counts already posted as adjustments need a reversing adjustment

rollback_method: Restore the balance snapshot taken at the go-live checkpoint, then apply the replayed movements and recount bins that moved
depends_on: Snapshot taken at go-live; no picks or putaways while the restore runs
point_of_no_return: The snapshot must be taken before any post go-live movement; without it balances have to be rebuilt by recount
